# Woman rural NPC source
Source: https://grab3d.com/models/characters/woman-base-character/
License: CC0-1.0, retained in LICENSE.txt.
Publisher origin disclosure: AI-assisted model/textures, cleaned and rigged in Blender.
The FBX and GLB are kept unchanged. Texture images were extracted from the GLB. Unity imports a Humanoid avatar and retargets the supplied locomotion controller.
Project-made fitted boots, fabric vest and conical hat are added. Four facial morphs provide six distinct identities per base model; the original bare-foot skin triangles are hidden under the boots in the derived mesh. Original source meshes are preserved.
